## Source: amazon-inspector (ddac804a8e64115b31c6c4a2e45417f7c283c358cf80f9a76391118861512d85)
Analysis of loadferry 0.1.0 on PyPI surfaced no indicators of installer harm. No install-time or import-time network activity, credential or environment scraping, filesystem persistence, lifecycle-hook execution, obfuscated payloads, or outbound beacons were observed in the shipped files.

## Source: kam193 (6d5ed5a4ca84e5e36cc5a87ee1ef6652bb96f1dbe1ef3340a041060c6bb9f477)
This campaign consists of similar loader packages, which provide executing code from a given URL. While they do not contain the malicious payload and the usage remains unknown, they are clearly a coordinated campaign to place multiple deceptive ways to load malicious code.
